subject: Travel plan confirmation before deadline
text:
Hi there,

I am trying to lock in the travel plan before the booking portal closes tonight, but I want to check one point with you. I see your note asked for an overnight arrival on the Tuesday before the client workshop, because you want to review the handover folder and settle before any client meetings. I understand why that feels safer, and I do not want to make the schedule unnecessarily tight. My only concern is the transit connection. The late shuttle from the airport drops people at the hotel before midnight, then there is almost no service the next morning, so the first meeting could start late if the hotel shuttle has a problem. I also noticed the training room cannot be accessed until 8 on Wednesday. Maybe we can choose a Tuesday evening arrival if we find a reasonable fare, but I would rather keep the Wednesday midday return than force everyone through a rushed Thursday morning. If you still prefer Tuesday night, I can book it and send a quiet reminder about the early start, and I will ask for a late check-in at the hotel. What matters to me is that the team has a calm route in, not just an extra evening in a new city. Let me know quickly, because the cheaper return fare is tied to a noon departure. I can also add the backup bus option, and it remains refundable until 5 today, which helps if plans shift before actual departure.
